item.title: Approach to Eltham Station from Well Hall Road needs urgent attention and cleaning., 20th August
item.description:
The ramp or walkway leading to Eltham Station from Well Hall Road is covered in weeds, dead leaves and very often litter. It appears to never get swept clean. It is a very depressing approach to the station and a doubtless a very depressing and drab arrival point for people arriving at Eltham Station for the first time. It is not a good advert for SE Railways or the Royal Borough of Greenwich, suggesting as it does urban decay and gross untidiness.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Well Hall Road, Eltham
Report on FixMyStreet
